description: Retrospective Oracle Watch trend for an asset: verdict stability, degraded-time ratio, worst deviation and mean credibility over the last N days, plus the recent series. Use it to judge whether a feed has been dependable, not just whether it is healthy this instant. History is guaranteed only for the committed universe (ETH/BTC/USDC/USDT x ethereum/arbitrum/base); other pairs return a live point signal from oracle_watch but no curve.

interval.description: Aggregation grain: 30min, hourly, or daily. Default hourly; 8-30d raw requests roll up hourly and windows over 30d roll up daily

name: oracle_watch_history
